title: BACK DOOR GLASS
ocr_text:
BACK DOOR GLASS

PREPARE ITEMS LISTED
(See page BO-31)

COMPONENTS

Nozzle
Wiper Arm
Clip
Back Door Glass
Dam
Moulding
Back Door Glass Spacer
High Mount Stop
Light with Bracket
Cover
Tonneau Cover Hanger
Back Door Trim Board

◆ Non-reusable part

REMOVAL OF BACK DOOR GLASS

1. REMOVE HIGH MOUNT STOP LIGHT COVER
(See step 2 on page BO-28)

2. REMOVE BACK DOOR TRIM BOARD
(See step 3 on page BO-28)

3. REMOVE HIGH MOUNT STOP LIGHT
(a) Remove the set bolts.
(b) Remove the wire connector from the high mount stop light bracket.
